原画锁全身比例、服装结构及道具
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Produce ONE premium cinematic 3D CGI character turnaround sheet, landscape 3:2. Exactly three full-body views of the SAME character side by side: straight FRONT, strict LEFT PROFILE facing left, BACK. Match heights and ground baseline. Complete headwear, feet and all appendages inside generous margins. Neutral warm grey seamless studio backdrop, subtle grounded shadows, no text, no borders, no environment furniture.
Reference 1 closeup is PRIMARY for current facial identity, species, eyes, grooming, material precision and rendering. Reference 2 original is authoritative for full-body proportions, exact costume construction, colors, props and front/profile/back structure, but NOT its linework, paper grain or flat shading. Newly render all details in high-end feature-film CGI with physically based materials, visible fabric weave, raised embroidery, anatomically plausible volume and clean contact shadows. Soft warm key and subtle cool fill, restrained highlights, crisp natural detail across all three figures, no depth of field blur. No redesign, plastic toy, painterly smears, oversharpening or added accessories.
Subject: Crocodile King, mature male finance minister. EXACT refined long crocodile muzzle, olive-grey individually resolved irregular scales, pale warm throat scales, amber eyes, restrained knowing expression, small visible teeth and gold round spectacles from closeup. Broad stout upright dignified proportions from original. Preserve deep brown long ministerial coat over brown waistcoat and trousers, white shirt, dark reddish brown tie, white pocket square, pocket watch chain, wide shoulder cape with finely raised gold botanical embroidery and star motif, two horizontal gold closures with four star-medallion discs. Coat must clearly open below waist to reveal TWO complete trouser legs, ankles and black formal shoes standing on floor. Thick crocodile tail emerges through rear coat split and hangs naturally behind, full tapering tail visible beside feet in profile/back, preserve original scale rows and back scutes. Closed dark brown gold-edged budget ledger tucked under one forearm and red fountain pen held neatly in that hand in front/profile, other arm relaxed or behind as original. Do not hold an open book or seated pose. Same accessories and accurate anatomy in all three rotations. Render rich wool weave, embossed leather ledger, fine gold-thread embroidery, distinct brass medallions, rough scales and subtle natural contact shadows. No throne, no royal crown, no dragon horns, no robe hiding both legs, no extra limbs.
visual_check: 目视检查正面、左侧面、背面完整；可见裤腿、鞋与地面承托，保留特写面部和原画服装道具。
known_limit: 细小纹样及视角间结构可能有生成差异，非精确建模结构图。
